notes: §2002:7.2.10.3 GR6 omits all text-1 when no WHEN is TRUE, with or without a WHEN OTHER (legs C-AFTER, D-OTHER). A TRUE WHEN with no WHEN OTHER keeps its text-1 (E-TRUE) under §2002:7.2.10.3 GR4, the rule that governs that branch; the literal 'or' reading would void GR4. Matched at --std 2002.
